short.en: A pattern of wins and losses

t.zh: 这次有两堆石子：A 堆和 B 堆。每次可以从一堆里拿 1 颗，或者两堆各拿 1 颗。拿走最后一颗的人赢。
t.en: This time there are two piles of stones: pile A and pile B. On each move you can take 1 stone from one pile, or 1 from each pile. Whoever takes the last stone wins.

t.zh: 「还剩多少」这回要用两个数来记，表就变成了一张棋盘：第 a 行第 b 列，是「A 堆剩 a 颗、B 堆剩 b 颗」的局面。
t.en: This time “how many are left” takes two numbers, so the table becomes a board: row a, column b is the position “a left in pile A, b left in pile B”.

t.zh: 三种拿法，对手分别落到「A 堆少 1 颗」（上面）、「B 堆少 1 颗」（左边）和「两堆各少 1 颗」（左上）那一格。规则和<level-ref to="nim"></level-ref>一样。拼好之后，看看整张棋盘上长出了什么花纹。
t.en: The three moves land your opponent on the cells “one fewer in A” (up), “one fewer in B” (left) and “one fewer in each” (up-left). The rule is the same as in <level-ref to="nim"></level-ref>. Once it is built, see what pattern grows across the whole board.

goal.zh: 每次从一堆里拿 1 颗，或者两堆各拿 1 颗，拿走最后一颗的人赢。算出每种局面下，轮到的人能不能赢。
goal.en: Each move takes 1 stone from one pile, or 1 from each; whoever takes the last stone wins. For every position, work out whether the player to move can win.

how.zh: 这一关会检查整张棋盘。通过后，看看「是」和「否」排成了什么样子。
how.en: This level checks the whole board. Once you pass, see how the “yes” and “no” cells are arranged.

hints.zh: 三种拿法：「A 堆少 1 颗」「B 堆少 1 颗」「两堆各少 1 颗」，三格都要读。
hints.en: Three moves: “one fewer in A”, “one fewer in B” and “one fewer in each”. All three cells need reading.

hints.zh: 每种拿法都取反，再一起接进「任一是」。
hints.en: Put a Not on each move, then wire them all into “any yes”.

body.zh: 「否」都落在 A、B 都是偶数的格子上。这样的局面，不管你怎么拿，对手都能把它变回「两堆都是偶数」。
body.en: Every “no” falls on a cell where A and B are both even. From such a position, whatever you take, your opponent can turn it back into “both piles even”.

body.zh: 这块电路板存进了元件箱，叫<part-ref to="judge"></part-ref>：读三个对手局面，判断这一格能不能赢。
body.en: This board has gone into your Parts as the <part-ref to="judge"></part-ref>: it reads the three positions your opponent could face and decides whether this cell wins.

note.zh: 两堆石子：每个局面 = 任一（对手局面取反）。
note.en: Two piles: each position = any (opponent’s position, negated).
